assessments.reasoning: The dynamic rule at jls-10.2-300 fixes the length of the same array object after its creation. The paragraph distinguishes that object from a variable that can receive a different reference. Section 10.7 identifies length as a final field recording the component count, including zero.

challenge.method: Read jls-10.2-300 and jls-10.2-310 with §10.7. On Temurin 21.0.12.1+1 for Windows, mutated a component, kept an alias, replaced the variable's reference with a zero-length array, and attempted direct assignment to length using javac --release 21.
challenge.results: The alias retained length one and exposed the updated component. The replacement object had length zero. The compiler rejected an assignment to the final length field. Each case agreed with §10.2.

limitations: The rule fixes the component count of each individual array object after creation.
